comparability_limits: Same 1,184 tensor payloads, but different artifact header, UUID and maintained chat-template resource; identical rendered/tokenized prompts are not claimed.
Fixed 131072 global KV capacity is a labelled local counterfactual, not automatic-capacity production or image/profile adoption.
Fork retains 60000ms keep-warm and separate 16GiB HostKV plus24 HostStateImage slots; upstream has no keep-warm and one combined16GiB HostContext budget.
Role decode includes reasoning-only completions; client failure counts and common non-error-answer subset are explicit. No powered quality screen was run.
Canonical probe uses new random nonces in each invocation; deterministic-input pairs also have within-arm output differences.
Two concurrent client submissions do not imply constant GPU batch2; both120K pair arms average batch1.0. Fork per-request preemption counters are unavailable, not zero.
Warm new-input hashes match3/3 but generated outputs0/3, so conditioned full histories differ after the first turn. No durable restart proof was performed.
Schema controls are single pairs in unconstrained-first order with different output lengths; 9/7-token tuple percentages are unstable small-sample evidence.
CUDA source was built and assigned methods were exercised; no build tests, formatters, linters, project suite, acceptance/watchdog, registry publication or release readiness check was run.

Upstream C4 throughput is failed, not zero: both six-image and four-image fixedKV attempts refuse startup; reducing K, KV precision, maxcontext or chunk would no longer answer the requested common-shape arm.

verdict.paragraph: Continue selective backport rather than re-port the fork's product features wholesale: a59c13d0 delivers299.71 versus81c8ce09 251.29 decode tok/s on84 matched server-completed role cases (+19.27% fork),15.12 versus18.39ms rounds, and shorter rounds at all four contexts. Upstream's schema controls pass5/5 at observed weighted +2.51% decoder time/token, but warm follow-ups are mixed (306.55/77.21ms versus128.22/125.03ms) and its automatic BF16 C2 shape refuses by561.47MiB. The source architecture still lacks the fork's durable disk session store. C4 also refuses by1127.67MiB even with no optional extra StateImages, so the requested C4 throughput is unavailable rather than silently measured at a smaller shape. Those individual schema/preemption capabilities merit selective study, not an unqualified product rebase or adoption.
